name: UI kit embed
description: The uiKit embed's scene: a box made in code, a draggable window with a button and its tooltip, a toast, and a dialog with a small form bound to the box (a slider, a number field, a checkbox, a select and a colour field) that the window's button opens, all from the UI kit. Mounted into a page it doesn't own, they size from the browser's font size and stay inside the mount's container.
